parse.title: Color tinting
parse.wikitext:
'''Color tinting''' is defined as a [[visual effect]] that can occur on low to moderate doses of certain [[classical psychedelic]]s. This effect manifests itself when the user's whole field of vision becomes tinted through a certain color as if a transparency or overlay filter is placed over one's vision. It is separate and distinct from [[color shifting]] or [[color replacement]].
